name: @barnlabs/lightningloop-harness
description: Shared LightningLoop policy, orchestration, and terminal harness

scripts.verify:lock-integrity: node --input-type=module --eval "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; const lock = JSON.parse(await readFile('package-lock.json', 'utf8')); const invalid = Object.entries(lock.packages).filter(([path, item]) => path && item.resolved && !item.link && (typeof item.integrity !== 'string' || !/^sha(?:256|384|512)-[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/.test(item.integrity))).map(([path]) => path); if (invalid.length) throw new Error('Lock entries without valid integrity: ' + invalid.join(', ')); console.log('Lock integrity verified for ' + Object.keys(lock.packages).length + ' package entries');"
scripts.test:portable: npm run build:harness && node --test dist/artifacts/browser-artifact-server.test.js dist/core/key-store.test.js dist/core/openrouter.test.js dist/core/platform-paths.test.js dist/core/pi-options.test.js dist/core/provider-profile.test.js dist/graph/promise-graph.test.js dist/search/search-client.test.js dist/update/update-policy.test.js
scripts.verify:harness: npm run check:harness && npm run test:harness
scripts.prepack: npm run clean:harness && npm run build:harness
